author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the five-finger home, finger numbers, spotting repeated lines and keeping up with the music, with a tune from Vivaldi's Spring.

classes.title: Find your five-finger home
classes.goal: Hear the song, then rest one finger on each of five keys, thumb on C.

mathTarget.parentLine: One finger for each key: five fingers, five keys

classes.parentPrompt: Help your child rest one curved finger on each lit key, thumb on C.
classes.childAction: Put one finger on each lit key, thumb on C.
classes.bridge: Your hand is a little nest: five fingers, five white keys, thumb on C.

intro.caption: Let's find your hand's home
intro.parentCue: thumb on C, just left of the two black keys.

games.caption: One finger, one key
games.parentCue: Point to each finger as it plays

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: one finger on each key, thumb on C.

classes.title: The birds sing on E
classes.goal: Play the first line with the right fingers, one finger per key.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each finger has a number; the numbers tell the tune

classes.parentPrompt: Say the finger numbers aloud together: one, three, three, three, two, one, five.
classes.childAction: Thumb, finger three three times, then hold a long five.
classes.bridge: The birds sing on E three times, then fly up to G and hold.

intro.caption: The birds sing on E
intro.parentCue: say the finger numbers out loud together.

games.caption: Birds sing: C, E, E, E

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a line with finger numbers.

classes.title: Find the copy
classes.goal: Learn the next lines and hear which part copies line one.

mathTarget.parentLine: Line two ends just like line one; spot the copy

classes.parentPrompt: Play line one, then line two; ask your child which part sounds the same.
classes.childAction: Play line two and find the part that matches line one.
classes.bridge: Line two starts high on G and F, then sings line one's ending.

intro.caption: Which part is a copy?
intro.parentCue: after both lines, ask what sounded the same.

games.caption: Line one, then line two
games.parentCue: Ask: which part sounded the same?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: spotting a part that repeats.

classes.title: Three flowers, planted twice
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly: three lines in order, then all three again.

mathTarget.parentLine: Three different lines, then the same three lines again

classes.parentPrompt: Hold up one, two, three fingers as each line starts, then start again.
classes.childAction: Play the three lines in order, then play them again.
classes.bridge: The song is three flowers in a row, planted twice.

intro.caption: Three lines, then all again
intro.parentCue: hold up a finger as each line starts.

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing three lines in order, twice.

classes.title: The sunshine wave
classes.goal: Practise the wavy line slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fingers rock down, up, down, like a little wave

classes.parentPrompt: Play it very slowly; gently touch the next finger your child will use.
classes.childAction: Rock fingers five, four, three, then back up, slowly.
classes.bridge: Sunshine on the grass is a wave: down, up, then down to D.

games.caption: The wave: G, F, E, F, G
games.parentCue: Gently touch the next finger to use

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: rocking fingers down and up, slowly.

classes.title: Count to four, slow and even
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and evenly, counting four beats in each bar.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting one to four keeps every note evenly spaced

classes.parentPrompt: Count 'one, two, three, four' softly while your child plays slowly.
classes.childAction: Play slowly while you count to four with your grown-up.
classes.bridge: Each bar is four even steps across the flower garden.

intro.caption: Slow and steady wins
intro.parentCue: count one to four softly as you go.

games.caption: Tap and count to four
games.parentCue: Count one to four out loud

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing evenly, counting to four.

classes.title: Up in the treetop
classes.goal: Play the song in a higher place on the piano with the same fingers.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song, moved to a higher home, sounds lighter

classes.parentPrompt: Slide your child's hand to the next C up: same fingers, same song.
classes.childAction: Move your hand to the high C and play the same song.
classes.bridge: Low C is the garden; high C is the treetop where birds sing.

intro.caption: Same song, up high
intro.parentCue: slide your child's hand to the next C up.

games.caption: Same song, two homes
games.parentCue: Ask: which one sounds more like a bird?

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing the same song in a new place.

classes.title: Keep up with the violins
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping your part going while the music moves on

classes.parentPrompt: Sit close and nod the beat; if a note is missed, keep going.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes are fine; keep going!
classes.bridge: The music is a spring breeze; ride along and never stop to look back.

intro.caption: Play along with the music
intro.parentCue: nod the beat and keep going, whatever happens.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music, together.

classes.title: Spring concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy, each line strong, then soft like an echo.

mathTarget.parentLine: Playing a line strong, then its repeat soft, like an echo

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; play each line strong, then its repeat soft.
classes.childAction: Play each line strong, then soft like a faraway bird.
classes.bridge: First a bird sings close by; then a faraway bird sings it back.

intro.caption: Concert time for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience.

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing strong and soft, start to end.
